explanation: The prop is gone, so a value that plugin templates pass as placeholder falls through as an HTML attribute, and plugin overrides that read this.placeholder get undefined.

explanation: The prop is gone, so a value that plugin templates pass as showClearableButton falls through as an HTML attribute, and plugin overrides that read this.showClearableButton get undefined.
